attributes.additional_details: The days off are up for negotiation, that could be 3 days off any day of the week, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday .
attributes.background:
As requested by my children, as representive for them, They are requesting that the school week be changed from 5 days a week in school, and 2 days off to 4 days a week in school & 3 days off. 
Alternatively the 6 year old has put forward counter offer of 10,000 days off school & 1 day in school

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Pilot a four-day school week in England
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/783101
